value.signature: fn collect_descriptors (& 'a self , rows : & mut Collected < 'a > , meter : & mut AuditMeter) -> Result < () , AuditFailure >

exception.justification: Justified: Descriptor collection inherits the enclosing metered audit operation.

review.body: { self . segments . for_each (& mut | (scope , segment) , descriptor | { let site = descriptor_location (scope , * segment) ; meter . reserve (& mut rows . descriptors , 1 , site) ? ; meter . visit (site) ? ; rows . descriptors . push (RawDescriptor { key : meter . key (scope , site) ? , scope , segment : * segment , first : descriptor . first , start : descriptor . start , parent_segment : descriptor . parent_segment , fork : descriptor . fork , cutoff : descriptor . cutoff , }) ; Ok (()) }) }
review.item_premise: The memory audit adapter checks a retained index inside the same bounded, observed audit invocation.
